subject: FORGE FINALE -- 29/45, five criteria today
body:
FORGE FINALE -- seven sessions today (38-44), 24/45 -> 29/45. Five criteria earned.

Worked straight through under your standing authority, no pauses. Earned: the derivation field on every human log line and a build check that provably fails on yesterday's build; every human line rewritten to clear its length rule with a real "what this means for you" clause; a multiplicity ledger that deflates by the whole research program's test count instead of each script's own loop bound; IC now published as a curve across ten horizons instead of a single point (this was the head of the doc's own critical path); and the uniqueness-weighted effective sample applied to real labels for the first time.

The honest headline from those three statistics criteria together: no horizon of the score's IC curve survives the family-wide correction on the effective sample. The two that looked significant lose to the corrected bar. The only survivors are same-bar contemporaneous measurements, which are not forward-predictive tests. That is the strongest form of the standing null we have ever measured -- but it is NOT the edge/no-edge verdict; C4 is that, and it stops and asks you rather than deciding on its own.

Also worth knowing: most criteria were blocked less by missing capability than by instruments measuring the wrong thing. One "MET" criterion was resting on a checker that only covered half its own rule, pointed at a file eleven builds out of date. Another's evidence cited line numbers that landed on unrelated code. The script that introduced the multiplicity ledger was itself registering ten tests while running a hundred and ten. All fixed, all re-measured, none of it papered over.

Three builds shipped, SLS(173)/(174)/(175), each 0 errors 0 warnings, deployed byte-identical to all three locations. No terminal at any point -- today was Sunday, market closed, so nothing live could have advanced regardless of authority. Everything terminal-gated (C7's forward clock especially) waits on the market reopening.

Tracker current. Next terminal-free work: purge/embargo on every split, the 55 remaining rate-report sites, and the rate-floor derivation.
